architecture.polyphony_mode: monophonic (sends polyphonic MIDI as a controller)
architecture.patch_memory_note: No presets; MIDI channel, octave stretch, bend range and hold mode are remembered.
architecture.summary: Two 4046-core VCOs with saw, triangle and pulse outputs plus an OUT that mixes whichever waves are selected by three buttons; shape (pulse width / wave shaping) with mod amount, and two FM inputs with amounts, normalled to LFO triangle, Env 1 and LFO triangle. A mixer adds noise and an aux input (VCO levels sit in the VCO sections). The opto-FET 2-pole Sallen-Key filter has separate low-pass, band-pass and high-pass inputs (low-pass normalled from the mix) and two FM inputs. Two ADSRs with separate gates; a VCA with drive, two AM inputs (Env 2, LFO triangle) and a drone/gated switch. Keys output pitch, velocity and gate; the joystick bends, glides, adds vibrato and holds.

modules.name: Keyboard, joystick and arpeggiator
modules.description: 32 velocity-sensitive mini keys (octave ±4); MIDI/USB to 1V/oct CV and gate (analogue pitch and gate path); arpeggiator; hold; local off.

modules.name: Joystick
modules.description: X: pitch bend. Y up: glide (more = slower), or vibrato depth with VIBRATO on (dedicated ~5 Hz vibrato LFO). Y down: momentary hold; click: latching hold.

modules.name: LFO
modules.description: Analogue LFO with triangle and square outputs and RATE; LED.

modules.name: VCO 1
modules.description: 4046-based VCO: saw, triangle, pulse outputs; OUT mixes the waves selected by the three buttons; shape with mod amount; two FM inputs with amounts; coarse, fine; level to the mixer.

modules.name: VCO 2
modules.description: 4046-based VCO: saw, triangle, pulse outputs; OUT mixes the waves selected by the three buttons; shape with mod amount; two FM inputs with amounts; coarse, fine; level to the mixer.

modules.name: Noise
modules.description: Noise source with output jack and mixer level.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Sums VCO 1 and VCO 2 (levels in the VCO sections), noise and the aux input.

modules.name: VCF
modules.description: Opto-FET controlled 2-pole Sallen-Key multimode filter: separate low-pass, band-pass and high-pass inputs into one output; cutoff, resonance (self-oscillates early); two FM inputs.

modules.name: Envelope 1
modules.description: ADSR with its own gate input and output.

modules.name: Envelope 2
modules.description: ADSR with its own gate input and output.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: VCA with input (normalled from the filter), DRIVE (overdrive), AM 1 (Env 2) and AM 2 (LFO triangle) inputs with amounts, and a DRONE / GATED switch.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Top-panel OUT (3.5 mm, unaffected by MASTER VOL); MASTER VOL to the rear line out and headphones.

indicators.label: KEYBOARD, LFO, FILTER, ENV 1, ENV 2, OUT LEDs
indicators.function: Activity of keyboard gate, LFO rate, filter, envelopes and output.

behaviours.name: Normalled signal path
behaviours.rule: With nothing patched: key pitch to both VCOs, LFO triangle to shape and FM 2, Env 1 to FM 1 (VCOs and filter), mix into the low-pass input, filter into the VCA, key gate to both envelopes, Env 2 and LFO triangle to the VCA's AM inputs. A VCO sounds only when a wave button is lit and its LEVEL is up.

behaviours.name: Multimode filter inputs
behaviours.rule: Separate LOW PASS (normalled from the mix), BAND PASS and HIGH PASS inputs into one 2-pole output; different sources can be filtered differently at once.

behaviours.name: Joystick
behaviours.rule: Left/right bends pitch. Up: glide (a little = quick, more = slower), or vibrato depth when VIBRATO is on (a dedicated ~5 Hz vibrato LFO). Down: momentary hold; click: toggle latching hold (also latches the arpeggio). Transmits mod and vibrato over MIDI.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator
behaviours.rule: Six modes (up, down, up/down 1 and 2, played, random) chosen by holding ARP and circling the joystick; up to six octaves; auto-syncs to analogue, MIDI or USB clock with selectable divisions; outputs clock while running.

behaviours.name: MIDI and CV
behaviours.rule: Class-compliant USB and DIN MIDI on channel 1 by default; analogue pitch and gate conversion; usable as a polyphonic MIDI controller; local off at power-up.

behaviours.name: Tuning
behaviours.rule: Temperature-compensated; warm up a minute or two. The VIBRATO tuning routine plays a note with octaves above and below while OCTAVE +/- stretches the octave scaling.

midi.note: No CC control of panel parameters (all analogue).

specifications.power: 9 V DC 600 mA or USB bus power

source_inconsistencies: Gearnews describes the VCOs as offering square waves; the panel and specifications say pulse (with shape).
Synth and Software says the joystick's down position duplicates the Drone/Hold function; other reviews and the guide describe it as keyboard hold, separate from the VCA's DRONE switch.
The guide says the reset clears the 'Pitch Bend range', but no method for setting the bend range is documented.
Reviewers note pitch bend appears to stop working while VIBRATO is on (observed behaviour, not documented).

modelling_gaps.detail: PWM provides only a getting started guide; panel details come from the patch-sheet graphic and control behaviour from reviews.
Modelled as one controller feeding the keyboard logic; its glide/vibrato/hold split is a behaviour.
Suren Forward patches record cables and wave buttons only; Paul's patches also record knob positions (approximate, read from the drawings).
